target.statement: Construct nontrivial pure Yang--Mills theory on R^4 for every compact simple gauge group and prove a positive mass gap.

proved_here.claim: Two-plaquette U(1) heat-kernel conditioning is the bridge density p_t(q)p_t(s-q)/p_{2t}(s).
In the Gaussian tangent bridge, the retained-coordinate response is 1/2 and the centered-fiber response is 0.
Covariance decomposes exactly into transported coarse covariance plus conditional fiber covariance, iterated across an RG tower.
proved_here.scope: abstract probability kernels with square-integrable observables

proved_here.claim: Independent defects on a graph of maximum degree Delta obey the rooted connected-set bound p(Delta^2 p)^(n-1).
Product measures satisfy TV(mu^m,nu^m) <= m TV(mu,nu).

conditional_bridges.claim: Fiber contraction plus summable defect errors and infrared clustering of the terminal coarse theory imply clustering of the original observables.
Reflection-positive Euclidean clustering yields a Hamiltonian spectral gap after Osterwalder--Schrader reconstruction.
depends_on: quantitative clustering on a dense observable core

open_frontier.claim: Construct gauge-covariant four-dimensional block maps and disintegrations with uniform locality.
Prove small fiber influence K_k<1 after quotienting retained gauge-invariant modes.
Control dependent large-field and topological defect polymers with summable R_k.
Prove ultraviolet-to-infrared basin entry with constants uniform in cutoff and volume.
Construct regulator-independent continuum Schwinger functions satisfying the OS axioms and nontriviality.
Transfer the Euclidean decay bound to a positive Hamiltonian gap in physical units.

non_implications: Small centered-fiber response in U(1) does not imply a nonabelian four-dimensional estimate.
Independent-defect subcriticality does not control correlated Yang--Mills bad blocks.
Fixed-block heat-kernel/Wilson convergence does not establish regulator universality when the physical block contains a diverging number of plaquettes.
A covariance decomposition is an accounting identity, not a mass-gap proof without quantitative estimates.
